svg.title: Token Exchange (On-Behalf-Of)
svg.desc: Token Exchange (On-Behalf-Of). Swap an incoming user token for a narrowly scoped one before calling a downstream API. Step 1, Don't forward the token: Forwarded as it is, Ana's token still says aud: orders-api, so the Inventory API answers 401. Step 2, Exchange it: The Orders API asks the token endpoint: Ana's token, its own token, and the API it wants to call. Step 3, A narrow token for one hop: The new token is for inventory-api only: still Ana, read-only, five minutes, act names the caller. Step 4, Every hop, its own token: The Inventory API exchanges again for the Pricing API. Each token is valid at one API only.
